component.name: soundglass
component.summary: A small, fast audio player and quick editor

description.p: soundglass starts playing at once, moves through a folder without a gap, and keeps your originals safe: edits are only written to a new file when you choose to save one.

It also edits tags and album covers, makes quick cuts, fades and loudness fixes, and offers optional local AI tools that remove noise, split songs into stems and transcribe speech, plus a practice mode with loops, a spectrogram, tempo, key and chords.
The player is complete: MIDI files play with a built-in piano, media keys work from any window, and several fixes for covers, effects and saving.
The first release: player, quick editor, tags, Practice mode and optional local AI tools.
